title: E-Resources
bodyHtml:
The Library & Information Division has approx. 396 nos. of e-resources including online e-journals, e-books, e-database, e-magazine and CD/DVDs/USB Flash Drive, etc. from various discipline i.e. Ayurveda, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Drugs, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology & Pharmacy, Pharmacovigilance, Vaccine, WHO Publications, Library Science, etc. Library has 401 nos. of Thesis/Dissertations/Project Report of various discipline.

The Library facilitates access to the DELNET database, which includes books, journals and articles, etc. along with the facility to borrow books through Inter library Loan and to obtain copies of journal, articles through DELNET. The Library also facilitates access to the One Nation One Subscription (ONOS) services.

Through ONOS, users can access more than 13,000 peer reviewed, full-text journals from 30 leading publishers, covering diverse areas such as science, engineering, medicine, social sciences, humanities and natural sciences.

These resources may be utilized for study, research and enhancement of professional skills of users.
